critiques.subject: Three people walking away in a wet parking lot under festive lights outside a building at night
critiques.mood: moody, wintry, urban-night with a festive touch
improvements: [MODERATE] Recover bright areas by pulling Highlights down (~-30 to -60) and Whites slightly down (~-10 to -25), then add a gentle S-curve to restore midtone contrast without clipping

[SUBTLE] Cool white balance slightly (Temp -300 to -800K) and reduce magenta/purple cast with Tint toward green (-5 to -15); optionally use HSL to tame overly strong reds/magentas in the building/signage
[MODERATE] Apply moderate noise reduction (Luminance ~20-35, Color ~20-30) and then add restrained sharpening with masking (Amount ~40-70, Masking ~70-90) to protect smooth areas

[SUBTLE] Use local adjustments to lift the subjects slightly (Exposure +0.2 to +0.5, Shadows +15 to +30) and add subtle texture/clarity on their silhouettes; add a light vignette (-10 to -20) centered on the walkers

[SUBTLE] Crop slightly from the top (and a touch from the left if needed) to reduce empty bright signage/windows and keep the trio closer to the upper third, maintaining leading lines from the wet pavement
preserve: The wet pavement reflections and night-time glow
The festive holiday lighting and candid street feel
critiques.notes: The image has strong atmosphere with appealing reflections and a clear narrative of people moving through a wintery, decorated streetscape. Main opportunities are highlight control, slight WB refinement, and noise management to keep the mood while improving clarity and subject separation.

improvements_detailed.action: Recover bright areas by pulling Highlights down (~-30 to -60) and Whites slightly down (~-10 to -25), then add a gentle S-curve to restore midtone contrast without clipping
improvements_detailed.reason: The canopy/sky area looks close to blown and overall contrast is a bit flat from the bright background; recovering highlights and shaping tone improves depth while keeping the night glow.

improvements_detailed.action: Cool white balance slightly (Temp -300 to -800K) and reduce magenta/purple cast with Tint toward green (-5 to -15); optionally use HSL to tame overly strong reds/magentas in the building/signage
improvements_detailed.reason: Mixed lighting creates a warm/magenta cast that muddies neutrals; a small WB correction keeps the festive colors but makes the scene feel cleaner and more natural.

improvements_detailed.action: Apply moderate noise reduction (Luminance ~20-35, Color ~20-30) and then add restrained sharpening with masking (Amount ~40-70, Masking ~70-90) to protect smooth areas
improvements_detailed.reason: Visible grain/noise in shadows and midtones reduces clarity; targeted NR plus masked sharpening preserves texture on the subjects and pavement reflections.

improvements_detailed.action: Use local adjustments to lift the subjects slightly (Exposure +0.2 to +0.5, Shadows +15 to +30) and add subtle texture/clarity on their silhouettes; add a light vignette (-10 to -20) centered on the walkers
improvements_detailed.reason: The bright background competes with the walkers; guiding attention to the subjects strengthens the story without changing the overall ambience.

improvements_detailed.action: Crop slightly from the top (and a touch from the left if needed) to reduce empty bright signage/windows and keep the trio closer to the upper third, maintaining leading lines from the wet pavement
improvements_detailed.reason: A tighter crop reduces distractions and emphasizes the human element and reflections, improving composition and visual flow.
